basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods, the Euphemia Bruns Apartments are an extraordinary opportunity for investors seeking to own a piece of The City's history. This completely vacant, 6-unit building is a true turn-key gem, offering an unmatched opportunity in a prime location in Russian Hill, a neighborhood known for its breathtaking views, historic charm, and exclusive atmosphere.     The property consists of six spacious 2-bedroom, 1-bath units, each featuring laundry hookups and plenty of natural light. Over the past few years, the current owners have invested approximately $1.5 million in upgrades, including electrical and plumbing improvements, a complete seismic-retrofit, and a newly installed fire alarm system. These significant upgrades have ensured the property is ready for modern living while preserving its historic integrity.     This is the first time in over 60 years that the Euphemia Bruns Apartments have come to market, making this a truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Whether you're seeking to rent, owner-occupy, convert to TIC, or capitalize on its location and views, this historic property offers endless possibilities. Don't miss out on this rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco's historic fabric.
